title.narrative: The dissemination of the 31st December 2016 Political Agreement in the 44 dioceses around the DRC.

description.narrative: Since last year, 2016 the political situation in DRC is going worse. The Constitution states a maximum of two terms for presidential mandate. The actual president, Joseph Kabila, second mandate ended in December 16th, 2016. Before this, opposition and civil society have denounced his inclination of Constitution change for endless mandates. People has many times demonstrated for elections in time. As we approached December 19th without elections, many appeals from UN, catholic bishops, ... invited president Kabila for action. He conveyed a dialogue attended by representatives from his side, some civil society members and one part of opposition, it was led by Edem Kodjo. An agreement was signed in October but it was rejected by the “Rassemblement”, an opposition coalition around Etienne Tshisekedi, as well by the international community. So demonstrations became numerous and many demonstrators were arrested and tens of deaths were reported. The bishop catholic conference (CENCO) conducted a mediation for a new dialogue. On December 31st, an agreement, more inclusive, was signed .Parties continued to discuss on application ways but were unable to agree. After four months of accompaniment, bishops, disappointed, stopped their mediation. President Kabila appointed in April a new prime minister. The Rassemblement, bishops, EU,.. denounced this saying that it is done against the 31st December Agreement. We are back to the starting point, spectrum of chaos and violence is pointing out again. In his last statement, the CENCO called people to take their destiny in hands. This project will help to translate in the four main Congolese languages-Tshiluba, Kiswahili, Lingala and Kikongo- the Agreement and disseminate it to the population to avoid the involvement in violence which results mainly from ignorance and will constitute a popular and peaceful pressure from people on the rulers to implement the agreement.
